attributes.name: identityId

attributes.name: realNameStatus

classes.name: Account
sourceRefs: 实验一需求规格说明书.docx 表1-4

attributes.name: accountId
attributes.constraints: 本行账户唯一标识；创建后稳定

attributes.name: customerId
attributes.constraints: 恰好归属一个 Customer；不能任意改归属

attributes.name: currency
attributes.constraints: 固定为 CNY

attributes.name: status
attributes.constraints: NORMAL、FROZEN、CLOSED；正常和冻结均计入未注销数；UC-AC-07 规定注销须 B=R=0 且无未决交易

attributes.name: bookBalance
attributes.constraints: 账面余额 B≥0；开户初始 0

attributes.name: reservedAmount
attributes.constraints: 占用 R，0≤R≤B；开户初始 0

attributes.name: activeFreezeReasonIds
attributes.constraints: 有效冻结原因引用集合；清空全部有效原因并有解除依据后才允许运营解冻

attributes.name: personalSingleLimit
attributes.constraints: 可选个人出账单笔限额；正数、两位小数；适用限额取个人与全局较严者

attributes.name: personalDailyLimit
attributes.constraints: 可选个人出账日限额；正数、两位小数；不替代全局限额

attributes.name: version
attributes.constraints: 从 0 递增；并发条件提交或等效锁机制使用；同一提交读取和验证

operations.name: availableBalance
operations.semantics: Return A=B-R from the same account version.

operations.name: assertCanAcceptNewDeposit
operations.semantics: New request only; require NORMAL; recheck inside admission commit. Do not call to reject an accepted transaction solely because it is now FROZEN.

operations.name: credit
operations.semantics: Positive exact amount; invoked only inside PostingService business commit.

operations.name: reserve
operations.semantics: Positive amount not exceeding available balance; preserve 0<=R<=B.

operations.name: debitReserved
operations.semantics: Debit B and release corresponding R together; C collaboration input.

operations.name: release
operations.semantics: Release a prior reservation once; cannot make R negative; C collaboration input.

classes.name: Transaction
sourceRefs: 实验一需求规格说明书.docx 表1-4

attributes.name: tradeNo
attributes.constraints: 全局唯一交易号；资金与外部处理沿用原号

attributes.name: identityId
attributes.constraints: 发起身份；是幂等作用域的一部分；不替代对象权限检查

attributes.name: businessType
attributes.constraints: DEPOSIT、WITHDRAWAL、INTERNAL_TRANSFER、EXTERNAL_TRANSFER

attributes.name: requestId
attributes.constraints: 同一身份、业务类型内由客户端提供的请求标识；不可重新分配以绕过重试语义

attributes.name: requestHash
attributes.constraints: 规范化业务内容摘要；不得将非法精度舍入为合法金额；同幂等键摘要不同时冲突

attributes.name: accountId
attributes.constraints: 请求主账户；存款为入账账户，出账为付款账户

attributes.name: amount
attributes.constraints: 合法已受理交易为正数、最多两位小数；非法请求细节留在处理记录，不能伪造成合法交易金额

attributes.name: currency
attributes.constraints: 固定为 CNY

attributes.name: status
attributes.constraints: 七种状态见第 3 节；终态不能被迟到未知结果覆盖

attributes.name: createdAt
attributes.constraints: 交易记录创建时间

attributes.name: acceptedAt
attributes.constraints: 正常账户及金额/限额通过，并完成受理提交的时间；受理前为空

attributes.name: completedAt
attributes.constraints: 进入 REJECTED、SUCCEEDED 或 FAILED 时记录；非终态为空

attributes.name: channelEvidenceId
attributes.constraints: 最近已验证渠道依据的引用；不得存完整令牌或敏感原始报文

attributes.name: lastChannelResult
attributes.constraints: 最近已验证的渠道结果；无依据为空；不得覆盖本地已确定终态

attributes.name: lastCheckedAt
attributes.constraints: 最近一次渠道查询或回执核对时间

attributes.name: failureReason
attributes.constraints: 拒绝/失败原因码或脱敏说明；不混存资金流水

operations.name: snapshot
operations.semantics: See account-domain design specification and sequence diagram; omitted context parameters are carried in request/identity value objects.

operations.name: markProcessing
operations.semantics: Admission after atomic status/limit recheck; set acceptedAt; may not dispatch channel before admission commits.

operations.name: markPending
operations.semantics: Conditional transition for unresolved accepted transactions; never downgrade terminal states.

operations.name: markSucceeded
operations.semantics: Only within successful complete business posting.

operations.name: markFailed
operations.semantics: Only after verified failure and all required release/recovery; deposit failure has no posting.

operations.name: markRejected
operations.semantics: Pre-admission rejection; acceptedAt remains absent.

operations.name: isTerminal
operations.semantics: REJECTED, SUCCEEDED and FAILED are terminal.

operations.name: recordEvidence
operations.semantics: Retain verified source, original tradeNo and matching business content before posting; contradictory proof requires reconciliation.

classes.name: FundEntry
sourceRefs: 实验一需求规格说明书.docx 表1-4

attributes.name: entryId
attributes.constraints: 资金事件唯一标识；创建后不可修改

attributes.name: tradeNo
attributes.constraints: 恰好关联一笔交易；保留原交易追踪号

attributes.name: accountId
attributes.constraints: 恰好属于一个账户；与 Transaction 的主账户角色不混淆

attributes.name: entryRole
attributes.constraints: 账户在该资金事件中的角色；用于业务去重；同交易同账户同角色唯一

attributes.name: direction
attributes.constraints: CREDIT 或 DEBIT；仅实际入账、扣账或已生效纠正产生

attributes.name: amount
attributes.constraints: 正数、最多两位小数；方向由 direction 表达

attributes.name: bookBalanceAfter
attributes.constraints: 同次业务提交后的该账户 B，≥0；用于核对追溯

attributes.name: occurredAt
attributes.constraints: 实际资金变化提交时间；非请求提交时间

operations.name: creditOf
operations.semantics: Factory for immutable actual credit event; caller supplies accepted transaction/account/amount/posting context.

operations.name: debitOf
operations.semantics: Factory for immutable actual debit event; caller supplies accepted transaction/account/amount/posting context.

attributes.name: transferType

attributes.name: payerAccountId

attributes.name: externalPayeeRef

attributes.name: amount

classes.name: ChannelGateway
sourceRefs: 实验二账户域设计职责提议

operations.name: requestDeposit
operations.semantics: Dispatch original tradeNo only after admission; timeout/unknown is not success.

operations.name: queryResult
operations.semantics: Reconcile the same accepted tradeNo; never create a replacement deposit.

operations.name: verifyResult
operations.semantics: Validate trusted channel source and matching tradeNo/account/amount/currency against read-only snapshot passed by control layer; no entity-store access.

classes.name: AccessService
sourceRefs: 实验二账户域设计职责提议

operations.name: authenticate
operations.semantics: Resolve authenticated identity from session; missing or expired authentication ->401.

operations.name: requireAccountAccess
operations.semantics: Check operation and object scope together: operation=DEPOSIT permits only ACT-C on own account; operation=READ_BALANCE permits own customer or staff with both role permission and explicit object-scope authorization. Read authorization never grants deposit permission; unauthorized->403; no foreign-data disclosure.

operations.name: requireAcceptedTradeAccess
operations.semantics: For customer/status queries authorize original trade; internal channel path validates trusted source and accepted transaction, never trusts client tradeNo alone.

classes.name: DepositService
sourceRefs: 实验二账户域设计职责提议

operations.name: deposit
operations.semantics: Orchestrate authenticated authorized admission/idempotency/validation/channel; malformed input refusal can use technical request record without invalid Decimal Transaction.

operations.name: confirmDeposit
operations.semantics: Verify source and original content; persist evidence, then request all-or-nothing posting or verified failure; accepted frozen accounts continue.

operations.name: queryAcceptedDeposit
operations.semantics: Authorize original accepted trade, query same channel tradeNo and reuse confirmation; no new channel deposit.

classes.name: IdempotencyService
sourceRefs: 实验二账户域设计职责提议

operations.name: claimOrLoad
operations.semantics: Atomic durable claim scoped to identityId+businessType+requestId; normalized content same returns original status, different conflicts.

operations.name: complete
operations.semantics: Store/rebuild current authorized processing result; Transaction stays the source of business state; does not create funds.

classes.name: AccountQueryService
sourceRefs: 实验二账户域设计职责提议

operations.name: queryBalance
operations.semantics: Read B/R/status/version from one consistent snapshot, call availableBalance(), return B/R/A; authorized frozen account can be queried.

classes.name: PostingService
sourceRefs: 实验二账户域设计职责提议

operations.name: completeDeposit
operations.semantics: Serialize concurrent confirmations; Account credit+FundEntry append+Transaction success in one business commit; rollback all on failure, retain evidence for retry; terminal duplicate returns original outcome.

operations.name: recordFailure
operations.semantics: Only verified definitive failure; conditionally write deposit failure without funds/entry; conflicting terminal proof requires reconciliation.

invariants.text: Per customer active(NORMAL or FROZEN) accounts<=3; historical count unbounded
New deposit requires NORMAL at atomic admission; accepted trade continues after freeze
Idempotency key(identityId,businessType,requestId); same normalized payload returns original state; different conflicts
Only verified channel SUCCESS can trigger credit; unknown remains pending, confirmed failure has no funds/entry
Credit+FundEntry+Transaction success commit all or none; concurrent/repeated confirmation once
FundEntry immutable, suggested unique(tradeNo,accountId,entryRole); entryId uniqueness alone is insufficient
Authentication and object permission precede account, transaction and idempotency result reads
UC-AC-07 close requires B=R=0 and no unsettled trade; unfreeze requires all active reasons cleared, risk-clearance evidence and operations authorization
Query uses one B/R/status snapshot; FROZEN permits authorized read-only query

valueTypes.name: Identity
valueTypes.notes: logical value object; no password/token logging

valueTypes.name: DepositResult
valueTypes.notes: invalid input rejection may have no business transaction number

technicalMappingNotes: Do not map every boundary/control class to a table.
Malformed non-Decimal requests are refused in durable request/idempotency technical records, not as bogus valid transaction amounts.
Channel evidence must survive local posting rollback and keep original tradeNo for reconciliation.
Architecture remains A decision; remote partial writes cannot be called an atomic business commit.
Audit and freeze-reason technical/logical mapping to be agreed by A/D; not an extra claimed core entity.
